thread:
olivia: Compliance escalated: DSAR requires full event history export + proof of access chain. Vendor (Amplitude) retention is 3 years; our policy is 90d. They also flagged a recent Amplitude CVE they patched.
ben: Okay. Two parallel tracks: 1) secure extraction + chain-of-custody artifact; 2) vuln triage with vendor.
rachel: For extraction flow I propose: vendor API -> filtered by user_id -> write to S3 prefix s3://priv-dsar/6143210987/ -> server-side KMS encrypt with key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/DSAR-6143210987 -> produce manifest + GPG signature -> record audit entry in internal AuditStore.
olivia: RBAC: retrieval must be via ephemeral role with principal session tagged dsar=6143210987, require MFA and approval from security+legal. No direct console download.
infra-bot: Example IAM condition we can use:
```
"Condition": {"StringEquals": {"sts:ExternalId": "dsar-6143210987"}}
```
ben: KMS key policy must enumerate the dsar-exporter service principal and include condition on EncryptionContext dsar_id. Also deny Decrypt unless session has tag dsar=6143210987.
audit-bot: Audit note: ensure CloudTrail records PutObject/GetObject with object tags (dsar_id) and include principalIdentity in evidence bundle.
rachel: We'll also run a PII-scanner (libpii v3) on the exported file and attach the redaction log to the artifact. If redaction applied, include both raw and redacted manifests with checksums; raw must be in KMS-wrapped archive and only accessible to security+legal with documented justification.
olivia: Vendor vuln triage: Maria in vendor-relations confirmed Amplitude issued patch V2026.03. Need vendor attestation that export endpoints were unaffected and signed statement. If vendor can't attest, pause and escalate to CISO.
ben: I'll prepare a retention-exception request: include justification, risk assessment, and expiration (default 7d pending legal). If accepted, update object's lifecycle to keep until expiry.
infra-bot: Packaging steps (CLI):
```
aws s3 cp ./events.jsonl s3://priv-dsar/6143210987/events.jsonl --sse aws:kms --sse-kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/DSAR-6143210987
sha256sum events.jsonl > events.sha256
tar czf 6143210987-package.tgz events.jsonl events.sha256
gpg --detach-sign 6143210987-package.tgz
```
rachel: After packaging, upload signed artifact and create AuditStore entry: fields: dsar_id, requester, legal_approval_ts, approvers, artifact_checksum, access_policy.
audit-bot: Reminder: evidence retention for audit trail should be >= 7 years per legal request; object lifecycle for raw payload can still be short (e.g., 24-72h) if retention-exception not granted.
olivia: Action items: Ben -> open RE ticket & risk note; Rachel -> implement exporter & PII scan; Ben & Olivia -> draft IAM/KMS policy PR; Security -> JIT approval flow.
privacy-bot: Also include requester proof (signed consent or identity verification) in the artifact. Do not include vendor API keys or ci tokens in logs. :lock:
ben: I'll loop vendor for CVE attestation and post vendor response here. If vendor confirms clean we proceed; otherwise CISO will decide.
olivia: Thanks. Keep thread updated. We'll mark this as high priority and require security+legal signoff before handing to Compliance.
